summary: International General Insurance Holdings filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Q3 2026 investor presentation (Exhibit 99.1), a routine foreign-private-issuer disclosure equivalent to a US current report furnishing earnings or investor materials. No transaction, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed; the excerpt is dominated by forward-looking-statement boilerplate and a business description of the Bermuda-domiciled specialist insurer. There is no special-situations event, deadline, or regulatory clock to track.
